Everyday Sourdough Sandwich Loaf:
- 500g bread flour
- 310g whole milk at room temperature
- 100g active sourdough starter
- 50g wildflower honey
- 40g softened butter
- 10g fine salt
Knead in stand mixer on speed 2 for 8 minutes until windowpane test passes. Rise for 4 hours, shape into log for standard 8.5x4.5 inch loaf pan. Bake at 190C for 35 minutes to an internal temperature of 96C.
